vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh37 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --dir_plugins <VEP_plugins release/116> --plugin MaxEntScan,<generated>/fordownload_synthetic[,SWA,NCSS[,verbose]] [--tab|--vcf|--json]
plugin_source: MaxEntScan.pm of the Ensembl VEP_plugins repository at its release/116 branch (commit 229bb64), mounted as --dir_plugins
fasta: GRCh37 chromosome 21 at its full length from Homo_sapiens.GRCh37.75.dna.primary_assembly.fa, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form
matrices: the MaxEntScan matrix directory both engines read is not committed: scripts/fixtures/maxentscan_fixture_matrices.py --seed 1 --out <generated>/fordownload_synthetic writes it (the manifest's `generated` block names the command and the sha256 of every file), a made-up directory, fabricated scores in the files MaxEntScan.pm reads from it (MaxEntScan.pm:104-105 and 824-826), the same bytes for the reference run and for every test run
input: variants.vcf: 21 hand-placed chromosome 21 records: 20 around the splice sites of two protein-coding transcripts, one on each strand: substitutions at the last exonic base and the second intronic base of a donor, at the second-to-last intronic base and the first exonic base of an acceptor, in the middle of an exon, eight bases into an intron and in a last intron; a two-base deletion in a donor, an insertion at an exon's end, a deletion spanning a whole exon, a multi-allelic substitution at an exon's first base, and one substitution upstream of the forward-strand gene; and one substitution in the two-base exon 21:30973548-30973549 of ENST00000309434 and ENST00000535441, inside the acceptor window of the intron before it and the donor window of the intron after it

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags (the container command above, the matrices generated by scripts/fixtures/maxentscan_fixture_matrices.py --seed 1), then tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --dataset mes=<reference>=<candidates> --k 200 --seed 1 --keep-records --include mes=<the record in two windows> --cache <converted slice> --covers MaxEntScan --covers api-params-parsing --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--dir_plugins --flag={corpus} --flag=--plugin --flag=MaxEntScan,{generated}/fordownload_synthetic --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh37 cache; the masked reference as described under fasta; the container run for the manifest's run and each flag set in the four formats; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (one per flag set) and classify (the manifest's run and each flag set, with --field for MaxEntScan_ref, MaxEntScan_alt and MaxEntScan_diff and, under verbose, MaxEntScan_ref_seq and MaxEntScan_alt_seq)
